RegionScopeStats.description:
Regional flood-scope adoption over the last 24 hours.

Two independent views, deliberately not merged — they have different
denominators and will not agree:

- Traffic (``total_messages``/``scoped_messages``) counts flood-routed
  channel-message packets across all channels, including ones we cannot
  decrypt. Broad coverage, but corrupt RF captures contribute false
  positives, hence ``false_positive_floor``.
- Senders (``total_senders``/``scoped_senders``) counts distinct message
  senders, which requires decryption and so only covers channels we hold
  keys for. Narrower, but noise-free and immune to one chatty node skewing
  the result.

false_positive_floor.description: Estimated false positives in scoped_messages, measured from transport-routed packets claiming a payload type the protocol does not define. A scoped_messages value at or below this is not evidence of regional adoption.
false_positive_floor.title: False Positive Floor

scoped_messages.description: Of those, how many carried a regional transport code
scoped_messages.title: Scoped Messages

scoped_senders.description: Of those, how many sent at least one scoped message
scoped_senders.title: Scoped Senders

total_messages.description: Flood-routed channel-message packets heard in the last 24h (unique payloads)
total_messages.title: Total Messages

total_senders.description: Distinct channel-message senders in the last 24h (decryptable channels only)
total_senders.title: Total Senders

Surface of telemetry scheduling derivations for the UI.

``preferred_hours`` is the stored user choice. ``effective_hours`` is the
value the scheduler actually uses (preferred, clamped up to the shortest
legal interval given the current tracked-repeater count). ``options``

should hide anything not in this list. ``next_run_at`` is the Unix

info.description:
MESHRIK exposes the MeshCore companion radio as a local REST and WebSocket API.

REST endpoints are mounted below `/api`. The live WebSocket stream is available at `/api/ws` for health, message, raw-packet, contact, and telemetry events.

**Trusted network note:** MESHRIK is designed for trusted local networks. Optional HTTP Basic auth can be enabled for the whole app, but operators should pair it with HTTPS when credentials cross the network.
info.title: MESHRIK for MeshCore API
